Thanks Marissa — I'll be there. A couple notes from the SE side as we prepare:

- If you can include a 90-day and 12-month token forecast (avg tokens per request, peak qps, expected concurrency), that lets us model both hosted vs dedicated economics.
- For dedicated capacity sizing we typically need: model(s) you plan to run, expected prompt lengths, and SLA targets (P95 latency target).
- I'll bring a quick dedicated-sizing checklist to the meeting so we can walk through any tradeoffs (e.g., batching vs instance count).

Sharing a checklist now: dedicated-sizing-checklist.pdf (see attachments).

If security wants to join, happy to add a short section about data flow, KMS options, and audit logs.

— Aditya
